guidance: Letters and signs form a counterclockwise spiral (G1 p088): spawn → S (south) → park → east deck → north street → west → north-west truck → skyway → roof → tape over the spawn alley
The car carrier's bed reads as a ramp aimed at the tunnel window ('suspiciously ramp-like', thumbsticks)
T floats inside the glass skyway over the north street: the secret area advertises itself from below (VG)
The roof-A bowl is the obvious thing to ride and supplies the jump's speed
The tape glow is first seen from the bowl exit, 1-2 s before the pickup (LP1 15:32.5-15:33); the remake paints a big green arrow on the correct ramp (LP12 19:48)
Night lighting: lit windows, the lit NEVERSOFT sign (A), the video screen and glowing icons stand out
Hidden on purpose: the tunnel, sucky room and office interiors; the tape is never shown from the ground in sampled frames though it is ≈ 20 m from spawn
designLogic: The tape closes a spiral: objectives are 'lined up one after the next from the starting point' (G1 p085) and the spiral of letters and signs ends at the tunnel and the tape (G1 p088-p089)
Close in space, far in route: the tape is ≈ 20 m from spawn but ≈ 90 s of designed play away; the TAS takes it in ≈ 5 s by climbing the alley wall
A letter marks the door: T sits in the tunnel, so S-K-A-T-E teaches the tape's access (G1 p089, p091)
The roof bowl is a speed battery that turns a stats check into a pump-then-exit skill
One hub, several spokes: Roof 2 Roof (tape), Billboard Grind, Sucky Room Gap, Death Grind; the remake labels the tape spoke with an arrow
Tape on the arc, not on a surface: only a committed transfer takes it, and the same arc pays Roof 2 Roof (2000)
Gap names hint at secrets: T 2 T Gap, Secret Tunnel Entrance, Tunnel Gap, Over The Tunnel and Roof 2 Roof are on the checklist
Glass is the door material: tunnel window, office, sucky room (taught in Warehouse: break the start-room window, G1 p045)
Costly late failure: a short jump drops you into the alley, the farthest point by route from the tunnel; G1 asks for 'at least a minute left' at the last sign
Layered height: street, ledges and rails (≈ 1-5 m), tunnel and skyway (≈ 6-12 m), roofs (≈ 10-15 m); the tape on the top layer
Reward on the landing: roof B's pool and rails for the pro score (G1 p094); the remake adds stat points, the plushie and a gap goal there
Career step: first tape that needs a secret corridor; combines glass, rail chains, vert pumping and a roof transfer
One-run design: LP1 takes all five tapes in one run, the last sign at the buzzer
remakeChanges: Tape unchanged in place and route; THPS 1+2 paints a large green arrow on the launch ramp (LP12 19:48; PS12 'ramp with an arrow on it')
E moved from a high rail over the north street (G1 p089) to a power line between two roofs reached via the walkway (PS12)
Office re-themed as a cinema with the same plateaus (Glass Gap, Big Ass) plus Box Office manual gap
New goals: 5 popcorn buckets (two on the roof route), Complete the Rooftop Gaps, Ollie the Parked Cars; signs moved
New gaps: Mechanic, Box Office, Skyway, Super Skyway; Over The Tunnel not listed by PS12
Scores raised from 15,000/40,000 to 25,000/90,000/175,000 and an 18,000 combo
transfer: Spiral to the centre: crystal mid-air between two roofs ≈ 10-12 m above the spawn street; other goals ring the blocks and end at a hidden entrance; straight-line ≈ 20 m, route long
Ramp-shaped truck bed into a breakable window ≈ 2-3 m up, then an inclined corridor with grindable barriers spaced ≤ 2 m so grind ollies (≈ 2.4 m pop) chain them

Roof bowl as speed battery: roof gap ≈ 11-12 m lip to lip, between the cruise ollie (≈ 9.4 m at 12 m/s) and the charged maximum (≈ 13.8 m at 23 m/s); crystal at the arc apex ≈ 1-1.5 m above lip height, ≈ 4-6 m out
Door marker: a level collectible inside the corridor, visible through glass from the street
Hub with three exits (crystal gap, trick rail to a billboard, kicker into a glass room); painted arrow on easier settings
Expert climb: wallride panels up the alley wall within wallie reach for a TAS-style skip
Cheaper recovery option: rope swing or speed pad from the alley back to the truck so a miss costs ≈ 15 s, not ≈ 45 s
